scripts.test: npm run test:search && npm run test:typescript
scripts.test:typescript: npm run clean && npm run build && node --test "dist/**/*.test.js"
scripts.check: npm run test:typescript && npm run check:transcript-store && npm run check:js && npm run check:site:static && npm run test:search
scripts.check:quick: npm run check:types && npm run check:js
scripts.check:ci: npm run check && git diff --check && git diff --exit-code
scripts.check:js: node --check scripts/build-search-index.mjs && node --check site/assets/js/search-core.js && node --check site/assets/js/search.js && node --check site/assets/js/site.js
scripts.serve:site: npm run build:site-content && hugo server --source site --bind 127.0.0.1 --port 1314 --baseURL http://127.0.0.1:1314/ancient-egypt-and-the-bible/ --appendPort=false --disableFastRender
